item.title: PIAA BOYS BASKETBALL: Abington Heights falls to Springfield in Class 5A first round
item.description: Abington Heights, the District 2 champion, lost to Springfield, the fourth-place team from powerful District 1, 49-47, at their home gymnasium Friday in the first round of the PIAA Class 5A playoffs.

item.title: PIAA GIRLS WRESTLING: Abington Heights’ Manning rolls into final
item.description: HERSHEY — Last time Hayden Manning faced Emmaus’ Olivya Kroope, she won by sudden victory. The Abington Heights freshman made sure it wouldn’t be that close Friday night on high school wrestling’s biggest stage. item.title: PIAA CLASS 4A BOYS: Doherty lifts Prep into second round; Valley View moves on
item.description: SCRANTON – Packy Doherty drained his final shot inside of the Xavier Center as the horn sounded to sub him out. With the Scranton Prep student section shouting and chanting his name, the Cavalier took a moment to soak it all in. One final time. One final moment inside a gym where he reigned supreme the last four seasons. item.title: PIAA GIRLS’ BASKETBALL: Lady Cougars cruise past Garnet Valley in Class 6A opener
item.description: Hazleton eased past short-handed Garnet Valley, 71-34, in the first round of the PIAA Class 6A tournament on Friday evening at Hughie McGeehan Gymnasium.

item.title: PIAA GIRLS BASKETBALL: Dunmore, Mountain View advance; Scranton bounced
item.description: Amanda Dempsey connected on three of her four 3-pointers in the second quarter and finished with 14 points, leading Dunmore to a 36-33 win over Mount Carmel on Friday night in the PIAA Class 3A girls basketball first round. Jackie Brown added seven points, and Janaya Martin, the hero of the District 2 championship game, added six points, including four in the fourth quarter, for the Lady Bucks. item.title: NCAA BASKETBALL: Lady Royals dismantle Framingham State in first round
item.description: SCRANTON — Things could not have gone better for the University of Scranton women’s basketball team in their NCAA Division III tournament opener. The Lady Royals turned in a record performance in dismantling Framingham State, 104-39, in the first round Friday night at the John Long Center. Five players scored in double figures for Scranton (28-0), which set a program record for points in a NCAA tournament game. item.title: Wallenpaupack Area swimmers win 2026 Mulrine Award
item.description: At the Les Richards Swim Tournament at Scranton High School in February, Lackawanna Swim PIAA presented the Gary Mulrine Sportsmanship Award to the Wallenpaupack Area High School boys and girls swim team, which was selected by league PIAA swim officials. Mulrine served for many years as swim coach and official in Lackawanna County. Les Richards, the namesake for the tournament, has served the region in many aspects of swimming. item.title: Sublimely smooth G90 a top pick for the value-minded plutocrat
item.description: The 2026 Genesis G90 is a four-door, five-passenger, full-size luxury sedan that isn't cheap, but it's a go-to choice for buyers-of-means with an eye on value.
